5.13 Storing Conditions, Notes column (spanning all three duration rows): 'Percentage of recoverable capacity 80%※2'. ※2: 'Percentage of recoverable capacity = (Discharging time after storage / Initial discharging time) ×100. The discharging time is measured by the discharge current of 0.65A until 2.5V of end voltage after the battery is fully charged at 25℃.'
6.2 Capacity ① 'Within 1 hour, after fully charged at 25℃, the battery is discharged with 0.65A continuously until 2.5V of end voltage at 25℃.' Criteria: More than 300min.
6.2 Capacity ② 'Within 1 hour, after fully charged at 25℃, the battery is discharged with 3.25A continuously until 2.5V of end voltage at 25℃.' Criteria: More than 54min.
6.3 Cycle Life, criteria: 'More than 38min.' — the discharge time measured per Item 6.2.② after 300 charge/discharge cycles at 25℃

6.4 Temperature Characteristics ① 'Within 1 hour, after fully charged at 25℃, the battery is stored at 0 ℃ for 3 hours. After that, the discharge time is measured Item 6.2.② at 0 ℃.' Criteria: More than 30min.

6.4 Temperature Characteristics ② 'Within 1 hour, after fully charged at 25℃, the battery is stored at 60 ℃ for 3 hours. After that, the discharge time is measured Item 6.2.② at 60 ℃.' Criteria: More than 50min.

6.5 Storage at Fully Charged State 'After fully charged at 25℃, the battery is stored for 20 days at 60 ℃. After the storage, the battery is set in 25℃ for 3 hours. Then, the discharge time is measured Item 6.2.②.' Criteria: More than 30min.
6.5 Storage at Fully Charged State, second criterion: 'Then, the same battery is fully charged again and checked the second discharge time by the Item 6.2 ② at 25 ℃.' Criteria: More than 40min

6.6 Storage at Full Discharged State 'After fully charged at 25℃, the battery is discharged by the Item 6.2.②. Then, the battery is stored for 20 days at 60 ℃. After the storage, the battery is set in 25℃ for 3 hours. Then, the discharge time is measured by the Item 6.2.② at 25℃.' Criteria: More than 50min.
